title: De Herbis
subject: botany
author: Hortulanus
passage:
Herba in horto crescit.
Aqua herbam iuvat.
Sol terram calefacit.
question: Quid herbam iuvat?
explanation: Aqua herbam iuvat. Water helps the plant.

title: De Animalibus
subject: bestiary
author: Viator
passage:
Lupus in silva ambulat.
Cervus lupum videt et fugit.
Corvus in arbore sedet.
question: Quis lupum videt?
explanation: Cervus lupum videt. The deer sees the wolf.

title: De Igne et Aqua
subject: elements
author: Ignifer
passage:
Ignis lignum urit.
Aqua ignem exstinguit.
Lapis in aqua manet.
question: Quid ignem exstinguit?
explanation: Aqua ignem exstinguit. Water extinguishes fire.
